en_title: Hideo Kojima Reviews Spider-Man: Brand New Day: 'It Felt Fresh, and I Really Enjoyed It'
cn_title: 小岛秀夫评《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》：很喜欢
subtitle: 孤独的彼得
opus_summary: 小岛秀夫发表《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》长评，称片中孤独的彼得·帕克令人耳目一新。他认为影片既延续前作又重置一切，兼具新系列开端与直接续篇的定位，感叹真诚创作愈发困难。

paragraphs.en: Movie critic Hideo Kojima has finally published his Spider-Man: Brand New Day review, and it turns out he "really enjoyed" its take on a "lonely Peter Parker."
paragraphs.cn: 电影评论人小岛秀夫终于发布了《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的影评，看来他「很喜欢」影片对「孤独的彼得·帕克」的诠释。

paragraphs.en: The cinephile, who also happens to be the mind behind game franchises like Metal Gear Solid and Death Stranding, took to X/Twitter to unleash his thoughts on the latest Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) movie. Coming in at a little less than 200 words and 1000 characters, it's safe to say he found a lot to think about in Tom Holland's latest swing at Spidey.
paragraphs.cn: 这位影迷同时也是《潜龙谍影》《死亡搁浅》等游戏系列的创作者。他在X上畅谈对最新漫威电影宇宙（MCU）电影的看法。这篇评论略少于200词、1,000个字符，显然汤姆·赫兰德最新一次饰演蜘蛛侠让他有不少感想。

paragraphs.en: "A lonely hero. A lonely Spidey. A lonely Peter Parker," Kojima said. "It felt fresh, and I really enjoyed it."
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫说：「一个孤独的英雄。一个孤独的蜘蛛侠。一个孤独的彼得·帕克。感觉很新鲜，我真的很喜欢。」

paragraphs.en: Followers know that Kojima will typically put a little extra thought into a longer review for movies that stuck with him, while the ones that didn't usually only get a sentence, if that. Spider-Man: Brand New Day falls into the first camp, with the review analyzing not only this weekend's box office hit but the MCU Spider-Man movies that have come before it, too.
paragraphs.cn: 关注小岛秀夫的人都知道，若一部电影令他念念不忘，他通常会为之写得更长、更用心；没有留下印象的电影，至多只会得到一句评价。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》显然属于前者：他的评论不仅分析了这部本周末的票房热门片，也回顾了此前的MCU《蜘蛛侠》电影。

paragraphs.en: "Until now, Spider-Man films have generally been grouped into self-contained trilogies," he continued. "With each new iteration, the cast and creative team changed, allowing the franchise to reinvent itself for a new era. This time, however, while both the cast and the story continue from the previous film, everything has been reset.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「迄今为止，《蜘蛛侠》电影通常按各自独立的三部曲划分。每次推出新版本，演员阵容和创作团队都会更替，让这个系列得以为新时代重塑自己。但这一次，演员阵容和故事都延续自前一部电影，一切却又被重置。

paragraphs.en: "The film focuses on Peter, once again alone, and the loneliness and inner conflict that come with that. It can be seen both as the beginning of a new series and as a direct continuation of the last one. A very clever structure."
paragraphs.cn: 影片聚焦再次孤身一人的彼得，以及随之而来的孤独与内心冲突。它既可被视为新系列的开端，也是上一部的直接延续。结构非常巧妙。」

paragraphs.en: Watched “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.” A lonely hero. A lonely Spidey. A lonely Peter Parker. It felt fresh, and I really enjoyed it. paragraphs.cn: 看了《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》。一个孤独的英雄。一个孤独的蜘蛛侠。一个孤独的彼得·帕克。感觉很新鲜，我真的很喜欢。迄今为止，《蜘蛛侠》电影通常按各自独立的三部曲划分。每次推出新版本，演员阵容和创作团队都会更替，……

paragraphs.en: Kojima then took the opportunity to take a broader look at filmmaking on the scale of something like Spider-Man: Brand New Day. He added that "striking the right balance between what filmmakers want to create and what audiences expect has become incredibly difficult," especially as social media amplifies opinions online.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫随后借机从更宏观的角度审视《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》这类规模的电影创作。他补充说，尤其在社交媒体放大网络意见的当下，「在创作者想拍的内容与观众期待之间找到恰当平衡，已经变得极其困难」。

paragraphs.en: "Genuine, heartfelt filmmaking is becoming increasingly challenging. Because of that, this is a film that puts the 'Brand' in 'Brand New Day' to the test, as part of a blockbuster franchise that simply cannot afford to fail."
paragraphs.cn: 「真诚、发自内心的电影创作正变得越来越困难。正因如此，这部片是在考验『Brand New Day』中『Brand』一词的电影：它属于一个根本承受不起失败的大片系列。」

paragraphs.en: While fans wait for to hear more from new Kojima games like OD and Physint , the game creator has used social media to connect with followers online by sharing everything from community creations to the music he's been listening to. His movie reviews are no doubt the centerpiece of his activity, though. We've covered his thoughts on films like Backrooms and Superman before.
paragraphs.cn: 在玩家等待《OD》《Physint》等小岛秀夫新作更多消息期间，这位游戏创作者一直通过社交媒体与线上关注者互动，分享的内容从社群创作到自己正在听的音乐都有。不过，他的电影评论无疑仍是其动态的核心。我们此前也报道过他对《后室》《超人》等电影的看法。

paragraphs.en: As audiences across the globe – Kojima included – head to theaters to check out the new MCU flick, you can see what IGN thought about it in our 7/10 Spider-Man: Brand New Day review . In it, we said the movie "effectively refocuses on the most reliable pillars of the webslinger: battling inner turmoil, swinging around NYC saving the day, and looking cool while doing so."
paragraphs.cn: 随着包括小岛秀夫在内的全球观众走进影院观看这部新的MCU电影，你可以查看IGN为《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》给出的7/10评测。我们在评测中认为，这部电影「有效地重新聚焦于这位蛛网英雄最可靠的支柱：与内心挣扎搏斗、在纽约市上空荡着蛛丝拯救世界，以及在此过程中帅气登场」。
